name: fmcg-business-review-team
description: FMCG distributor business review team covering data alignment, gross-margin and expense attribution, category and channel structure, and management-ready review reporting

displayName.zh: 经销商经营复盘专家团

profession.zh: 经销商经营复盘专家团

displayDescription.en: Four roles work under one lead: align data definitions, attribute margin and expense, break down category and channel structure, then compile a review deck with conclusions and owners
displayDescription.zh: 四岗协同：先对齐数据口径，再做毛利与费用归因、品类渠道结构拆解，最后汇编成带结论与责任人的复盘报告

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把上个月的经营情况复盘一下：出货、回款、毛利、费用和库存都要看，最后给我一份能上经营例会的材料。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review last month's business across shipments, collections, margin, expenses and inventory, and produce management-ready material.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把上个月的经营情况复盘一下：出货、回款、毛利、费用和库存都要看，最后给我一份能上经营例会的材料。
quickPrompts.en: Run a full monthly business review and produce meeting-ready material.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个月毛利掉了，帮我拆一下是价格、结构还是费用的问题
quickPrompts.en: Gross margin dropped this month; break down price, mix and expense effects

quickPrompts.zh: 按区域和渠道做一版目标完成度分析
quickPrompts.en: Analyze target attainment by region and channel
